title: 滇中合院 / 团结乡风化院落 Three.js 参数化生产体系
purpose: 从团结乡高精度扫描中提取可复用的墙体、瓦作、木作、门洞、柴屋、楼梯和院落布局规则；不替代扫描 GLB，也不把未测量细节伪装成实测数据。

assetContract.exportPolicy: source-first; GLB optional for downstream snapshot only

performanceSeedBudget.targetMeshCount: 1200-1800 for prototype with independent tile pieces

architectureGrammar.family: 滇中一颗印 / 四合院落
architectureGrammar.primaryRule: 方形边界 + 中心天井 + 正房中轴 + 两侧耳房 + 前方倒座/门廊
verticalStack: 收分夯土或砖土围护墙
木梁架与木质围廊分隔
正房二层为祖堂/粮仓/卧室，耳房略低
各房独立双坡屋面，正房屋脊最高
planRules: 外墙高耸少开窗；外侧主要保留小而高的窗洞
中心天井作为采光、排水、通风和日常活动核心
正房、耳房朝天井一侧挑出腰檐，形成环形檐下通道
耳房与正房转角处用单跑日常楼梯连接楼层
门前左右可有小型柴屋/畜厩/储藏体量，体量低于正房
门洞是完整墙体中的结构开口，不能用悬空门片替代
constructionRules: 外墙木柱不在夯土外侧裸露；柱脚与转角可见石作或包脚
圆木柱优先，梁柱采用穿斗式/抬梁式混合语法，按证据逐步细化
墙体底部更厚、顶部内收，檐口与山墙相接不留扫描式大缝
各坡面互不穿插，瓦面连续覆盖至檐口；屋面边角用独立收头件

weatheredEarthWall.appearance: 暖红土黄主体、粗颗粒剥蚀、浅灰白暴露斑、深色雨流和底部污染
weatheredEarthWall.geometry: battered wall prism with optional gable; bottom wider than top

yunnanPanCoverTile.appearance: 低饱和灰色旧陶瓦，板瓦承水、筒瓦压缝，一片一片形成粒状檐口
yunnanPanCoverTile.geometry: independent curved pan and cover pieces repeated by course and overlap
yunnanPanCoverTile.material: cool/warm grey ceramic variation with rough matte wear

agedTimber.appearance: 灰棕到深棕，哑光，受雨木作变灰，檐下较深

productionModules.role: 可日常使用的踏步与扶手
门前低矮柴屋/储藏体量

exactDimensionBoundary.canonicalSeed: YKY measured three-bay case may seed proportions only
exactDimensionBoundary.tuanjie: Do not claim measured dimensions from the scan display bounding box
exactDimensionBoundary.evidenceRule: new user-supplied measured drawing or calibrated survey overrides the seed

qualityGates: wall material visibly zoned with exposure and dark flow variation
wall geometry has measurable bottom-to-top batter
roof uses discrete curved pan/cover pieces; no corrugated metal-sheet substitute
tile pieces have explicit course, side, index and evidence metadata
columns are round and timber is hidden behind earth walls on exterior faces
door is a real opening with recess, frame and leaves
front sheds are lower volumes and stairs are daily-use riser/tread sequences
small high windows remain sparse on exterior walls
all meshes remain editable through named groups and source module
unresolved dimensions are marked and never silently guessed
rejectedShortcuts: flat colored wall without weathering zones
large exterior windows inconsistent with high-wall privacy
exposed timber columns outside earth wall without evidence
single monolithic GLB as the only production source
